children: Eaton recast prior-period segment disclosures to reflect a new Mobility segment created in Q1 2026.
Filed Form 8-K to recast parts of the 2025 Form 10-K (MD&A, financial statements, business and exhibits) for segment reporting changes.
Re-segmentation: new Mobility segment combines legacy Vehicle and eMobility reporting units; historical segment data have been recast.
Exhibit 99.1 includes recast Part I Item 1, Part II Items 7 & 8, and Part IV Item 15; unaffected portions of the 2025 10-K remain unchanged.
Independent auditor's report (Ernst & Young LLP) on 2025 consolidated financials is included and remains unchanged except for dual dating to reflect recast.
Company notes this filing is not an amendment or restatement of audited financial statements and does not update other 2025 disclosures beyond the recast.
